versions.changelog:
WeChat Contact List Video Extraction & CRM Analyzer 1.0.0

- Initial release of a macOS-based tool for extracting WeChat personal contacts via screen recording, ensuring zero-risk and no system permission requirements.
- Utilizes FFmpeg for high-FPS frame extraction and Apple Vision OCR with concurrent processing for rapid text recognition.
- Implements rule-based NLP to parse contact details (Name, Title, Organization, Venue, City, Time) into structured data.
- Outputs results in Excel/CSV, JSON, and interactive HTML dashboards for CRM applications.
- Includes detailed usage guide covering best practices for WeChat contact remarking, extraction performance metrics, and command-line steps for end-to-end operation.
